_status: PROPOSED - not yet approved by the user. Do not treat decisions made with this file as final until the user explicitly approves these numeric thresholds. Once approved, this file is frozen: no further edits without explicit user approval, and gates.py records its SHA-256 with every decision so drift is detectable.
_source: research/validation-protocol-v2.md and the task's explicit gate list.

lookahead.rule: lookahead-analysis must report no detected bias (has_bias == false) for every tested cost scenario and split.

recursive.rule: recursive-analysis must report stable indicators after the strategy's startup_candle_count; any reported instability beyond startup fails this gate.

minimum_trades.rule: Below this many trades in a split, the decision is 'inconclusive', never 'candidate_for_portfolio', regardless of other metrics.

multiple_testing_penalty._rationale: Each extra variant tested in the same family is another draw from the same noisy history, so the best of N draws looks better by chance alone (multiple comparisons / backtest overfitting; see Bailey and Lopez de Prado, 'The Deflated Sharpe Ratio', Journal of Portfolio Management 2014, and Bailey, Borwein, Lopez de Prado and Zhu, 'Pseudo-Mathematics and Financial Charlatanism', Notices of the AMS 2014). This linear rule is a deliberately simple stand-in, NOT a formal deflated Sharpe ratio: it only makes the bar rise as the family grows. variants_tested_in_family counts hypotheses registered in the same family BEFORE the one being decided, as given by registry.count_prior_variants().

net_profit.rule: Net profit (quote currency) must be strictly greater than required_net_profit_quote in both the base and conservative cost scenarios. With zero prior variants the bar is base_threshold_quote; it rises with every earlier variant in the family. base_threshold_quote is in the stake currency of the 100 USDT dry-run wallet (1.0 = 1% of the wallet) and is a PROPOSED value.

profit_excluding_best_trade.rule: Net profit recomputed with the single best trade removed must still be > 0, in at least the base cost scenario, to avoid single-trade dependence.

max_drawdown._amended: 2026-11-06 by the owner (Luiz Kelme): the stress scenario (0.90% round trip) is reported, not gating, so day-trade rules are judged on realistic costs for 10-100 USDT orders on BTC/ETH/BNB.
max_drawdown.rule: Max drawdown (as a fraction of peak balance) must be <= 25% in every scenario listed in max_drawdown.scenarios; the other required scenarios are reported.

benchmark_comparison.rule: Must report strategy result against cash (0% return) and buy-and-hold over the same split and period. Beating either is not required, but both comparisons must be present in the metrics before a decision is produced.

split_progression.rule: A strategy must clear every gate above on the exploration split, and then again independently on the validation split, before the decision can be 'candidate_for_portfolio'. A candidate must additionally clear the consistency and correlation criteria in lab/config/portfolio.json before it is included in a portfolio. The final_test split is never read by gates.py while splits.json final_test.final_test_unlocked is false.

decision_values._note: There is no 'approved for live' value. This lab never approves live trading.
